The generic suffix receipt retains stale ASCII, so later exact manual and two-word correction frames no longer match. Six rich-field regressions appear in the aborted full native run.

decision: Before clearing unchanged entirely owned user-input preedit, capture its current observed full end-caret birth snapshot and exact word plus one Space. After successful existing CommitText, arm existing ImeActiveComposition visible postcondition with full expected snapshot. Within the same receipt epoch/deadline, actual equality of full old prefix plus word and one final NBSP may update only that newly emitted boundary through acknowledge_owned_space_tail. Preserve immutable dispatch identity. Exact ASCII observation remains accepted. No feedback is attached.
guards: Current owned preedit witness, focus receipt/serial, runtime lease, layout generation and observation revision before dispatch.
Unchanged user-input word, end caret, empty right suffix, nonsensitive content, unsealed context, no atomic operation.
Existing receipt epoch/deadline, current path identity, exact unchanged owned tail and complete expected client snapshot.

Verified correction/completion and receipts without actual owned-start proof do not gain this presentation rule. No generic whitespace normalization or source-free word-completeness promotion.
